g.inkscape:label: 01 - Header
g.text: One icon only. Edit the large folder icon, then export the object “iconExport”.

g.inkscape:label: 05 - Export notes
g.text: 3. Set width = 24 and height = 24, or export 16 / 20 / 24 / 32 / 48 as needed.
4. If the size stops being square, you probably deleted “exportBounds”. Undo or restore it.
Editable object path: layerIcon → iconExport → iconGlyph → folderPath
Important: keep exportBounds at x=0, y=0, width=24, height=24.
